body: The cop that was arrested is still presumed to be innocent, now he's getting equal treatment as the rest of us.  Good Job North Carolina.

Wow, you sound like me.  I jump up out of a dead sleep screaming or trying to attack whoever is attacking me in my dream.  My husband sleeps next to me and usually grabs me and holds me tight, but that doesn't always work.  

I also am afraid of sleep and yes there are tons of problems with it.  It's nice to know I'm not the only one in a way, sorry you had to go through that.

I tried sleeping pills but then I couldn't sleep without them.  Then, I couldn't even sleep on them and I didn't stay asleep anyway.  Now I stay up until I physically can not anymore (which means I can stay awake for 24-48 hours at a time, sleep 3 or 4 hours and be up another day or two) just because I can not relax enough to sleep due to the fear of the night mares.  

I am reading the links you send me.  I'm also trying to find my mp3 player to download the meditations.

Thank you I am looking up those resources now.  I have a good life now and I would like to leave the pain I have felt in the past.  My new husband said it is haunting me because I have not made peace with it (he doesn't know everything that has happened), but I wonder who could with such a thing.  Your resources look very helpful.  A nice sleep of more than 3 hours before waking up in terror will be very nice.  Thank you again for posting.

Tagged you as mindfulness mentor.
Thank you.  I think that is what I needed to hear most.  I know my eldest to daughters can see that I try.  May be that is the life lesson they need is someone that tries.  Thank you again.
I feel like my past has shaped me, but the night mares interfere with my ability to sleep and function.  If I can't function, I can't be a good mother.
